title: Which part would you play?
sub: All you do is pick your way through twelve scenes. At the end, the part you'd be cast in.
disclaimer: Just for fun. Twelve scenes can't tell you who someone is.
name_hint: A few of the scenes will call you by it.
headline: The {temper} {role}
premise: You've just started at the company, and one season passes. Somewhere in there, one person keeps turning up wherever you are. Every so often somebody says your name. Which part you're playing comes at the end.

recap.seung_romance: Three scenes and you've been looking at one person the whole time. The group chat got there first.
recap.seung_presence: You've ended up at the centre of every room so far. People turn your way to talk now.
recap.seung_warmth: You keep checking on everyone, and nobody asked you to. Nobody's noticed either.
recap.seung_mischief: You've tipped over two of the last three scenes. The office looks slightly worried.
recap.jeon_romance: You can't play it off any more. Whatever you do next, everyone reads it as an answer.
recap.jeon_presence: The room goes quiet when you talk. It's been like that since the 회식.
recap.jeon_warmth: You haven't told anyone what you saw on the roof. They know that you haven't.
recap.jeon_mischief: Nothing you touched stayed where it was. The story has given up on stopping you.
recap.gyeol_romance: Everyone knows. The only question left is whether you say it or wait for the snow.
recap.gyeol_presence: You're in the last act because you walked here. You didn't step back from the envelope either.
recap.gyeol_warmth: You were the one still in the corridor at four in the morning. They all remember.
recap.gyeol_mischief: Someone asked you for three months of pretending and you laughed and said yes. One scene left.

type.lead_direct: The camera finds you the second you walk in. You say the line in episode two that everyone else was saving for the finale.
type.lead_careful: You carry the whole thing without ever raising your voice. Twelve episodes of waiting, and it lands because you made them wait.
type.firstLove_direct: You said it first, before either of you were ready. Whatever happened after, that's the scene people rewatch.
type.firstLove_careful: You never actually said it, which is why you're still in their head. Somebody still has the umbrella you lent them.
type.spark_direct: Two episodes of bad timing and you'd just ask. Great for the audience, a nightmare for the writers.
type.spark_careful: You two keep reaching the same door a minute apart. Nothing's been said, everyone can see it, and that's the whole genre.
type.second_direct: You say it in episode eight and step back cleanly when they pick someone else. Half the audience switches sides that night.
type.second_careful: You're the one who noticed they hadn't eaten. You'll never say it, and people will argue about you until the finale.
type.rival_direct: You turn up late, better dressed, and say the thing nobody wanted said. You're right, which is the annoying part.
type.rival_careful: You don't compete. You just keep turning out to have been right. By the time anyone notices, you're three scenes ahead.
type.bestie_direct: You take every scene you're in, and you weren't even meant to be in half of them.
type.bestie_careful: You drive them home, you remember what they said in episode one, and you never make it about you. They'd be lost.

intern.title: First day. Your 사수 walks you round the team. “This is {name}, starting with us today.”

options.stare: You're being introduced, and you're looking at the one from the corridor
options.brief: A short bow. You answer what you're asked and nothing more
options.learn: You meet each pair of eyes and say the name back
options.mutter: “Looking forward to it.” And under your breath, “help.”

elevator.title: Of all the lifts, this one — with the person you've been avoiding. Twelve floors to go.

options.mirror: You watch the floor numbers. In the mirror, they're watching you
options.hold: Their hands are full, so you hold the door without saying anything
options.joke: “If this thing stops, we're on the news, right?”

rumour.title: The office group chat has already decided. “{name} and them — there's something going on, right?”

options.silence: You read it and don't reply. Next day nobody brings it up
options.offer: You go to them first. “If this bothers you, I'll put a stop to it”
options.rename: You say nothing and quietly rename the chat

hoesik.title: Round two of the 회식. The 부장 puts a microphone in your hand. “{name}, one song.”

options.ballad: You queue a ballad and don't look at one particular person
options.stand: You stand up and take the mic. The singing is a separate problem
options.swap: You put the 부장's own favourite in instead
options.tambourine: You pick up the tambourine. You do not sing

rooftop.title: The roof. They're up there alone, and they've clearly been crying.

options.beside: You go and stand next to them, in a way that says you're not leaving
options.coffee: You go back down, then come up again and leave a coffee
options.tissue: You hand them a tissue. “Take your time”
options.weather: “Windy up here.” You start somewhere else

rival.title: The building owner's son has noticed them. Neither the car nor the man is from around here.

options.overtime: You say nothing. You stay late with them instead
options.between: “And you are?” You end up standing between them
options.defer: If they're happy, you decide that's the right answer
options.photo: You photograph the car and post it to the group chat

mother.title: Their mother asks to meet. She sits down and slides an envelope across. “So you're {name}.”

options.refuse: You leave the envelope where it is. “I'm not taking that”
options.return: You push it back and hear her out, politely, to the end
options.listen: You start with “I know you're worried”
options.open: You open it and ask what exactly it's for

hospital.title: Two in the morning, a hospital corridor. Nobody has told you anything.

options.wait: You sit at the end of the corridor and wait for morning
options.family: You go to the nurses' station and say you're family
options.porridge: You go down to the shop for porridge and a blanket
options.talk: You've been talking to the person in the next chair for an hour

contract.title: “{name}. Three months. Could you pretend we're together?”

options.terms: You ask to write it down. Term, scope, how it ends
options.why: You ask why first. How bad is it
options.rings: “Sure.” Next day you turn up with matching rings

snow.title: First snow. You both remember saying you'd meet when it came.

options.go: You just go to the place. You don't message
options.snowman: You build the snowman first and send the photo

wrist.title: In front of everyone, they take you by the wrist.

options.follow: You don't pull away. You go with them
options.greet: You free your hand and say hello to the room first
options.regrip: You change the grip. Hand, not wrist

ramyeon.title: Late, outside their building. “{name}, want to come up for ramyeon?”

options.stay: “Forget the ramyeon.” You stay exactly where you are
options.two: “Put the water on. I'm having two”
